chunk_1_rerun.reason: data.brreg.no was briefly unavailable while the first batch of 100 ran (58 profiles came back with failed registry claims); the same 100 organisation numbers were re-run and replace that batch.

precision_fix_rerun.reason: Independent review after the corpus was generated found the discovered-website acceptance rules too loose: directory/listing pages keyed by org number, confirmed non-company domains (Spotify, LEI/company-data directories, a menu directory, etc.), a football club's site accepted for an unrelated company sharing a short brand word, a relative JSON-LD url published as the website verbatim, and a company's real site carrying a leftover web-agency template url pointing at a different domain. All five are now rejected; the affected companies (about 6% of discovered websites) were re-run with the fixed code.
